EPFO Portal Services Remain Unavailable Due to Upgradation

The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) portal experienced a shutdown on July 1st, preventing members from accessing services like withdrawing PF funds. This outage is attributed to an ongoing upgradation process. Services are expected to resume on July 2nd.
